capabilities: switch to the last active tab with a hotkey (Alt+Q by default)
toggle back and forth between the two most recent tabs
customize the switch hotkey in Obsidian's hotkey settings
extras: README lists unimplemented future features (cycling through more tabs by history, visual cues), so planned behavior is not yet available.
intentEvidence: existing tab switchers on Obsidian don't seem to have this functionality
motivation: The author was used to Tab Manager Plus on Chrome, which switches to the previously active tab via a hotkey, and wanted the same behavior in Obsidian.
problem: Obsidian's existing tab switchers cycle through panes but offer no shortcut to jump back to the previously active tab.

relations.evidence: As a heavy user of Tab Manager Plus on Google Chrome

summary: Hotkey plugin that toggles between the currently active tab and the most recently used tab in the workspace.
